cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Three additional hooks in Ad 1's lane: literal pregnancy read, clock-driven. Art direction identical to MOT-PREG-MIRROR (fogged mirror, torso doodles labelled BACKED UP... -> MOVING!, hand holding the Motilli jar bottom right, 4:5). Body copy from 'Your colon is a muscle...' down runs UNCHANGED from Ad 1 in all three, so this is a clean hook test. Only the mirror line and the two opening paragraphs change.
MIRROR COPY

IF YOU GO UP A DRESS SIZE
BETWEEN LUNCH AND DINNER,
THIS IS FOR YOU.

cards.title: VISUAL

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text:
The dress fit when you put it on. By dinner you are standing differently in it and holding your stomach in without having decided to.

Fat does not arrive between lunch and dinner. What changes shape that fast is what is already inside you, sitting still.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text:
Your youngest is in their twenties. Your stomach did not get the message.

At this age it lands as something you have to explain, and most days you would rather put on the looser thing and skip the conversation entirely.

None of that is fat. A stomach that is flat before breakfast and hard by two in the afternoon is holding what should already have moved through.

cards.text:
Someone looked at your stomach, smiled, and said something kind. You corrected them and you both laughed about it.

You will think about it again tonight. They have already forgotten.

Fat does not do that to a person by two in the afternoon. A stomach that is flat before breakfast and hard by mid-afternoon is holding what should already have moved through.

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: FLAG · 01D ONLY
cards.text:
01D is the 'when are you due' beat. The angle record (MOT-A-002.1) marks it as DRAMATISED and not in the corpus, and requires it be labelled a creative choice rather than a testimonial.

It survives here only because it is phrased as self-identification addressed to her ('if someone has...'), never as a customer's account.

Do not let this line migrate into a UGC script, a review card, or anything that reads as testimony.

cards.title: SHARED BODY COPY
cards.text:
All three run Ad 1's body unchanged from 'Your colon is a muscle...' through the guarantee and getmotilli.com. Butyrate loop, why laxatives and coarse fiber fail, apigenin that stays in the colon plus soluble fiber that feeds the butyrate makers, three gummies before bed, not a laxative, day-five timeline, two separate systems for GLP-1, ninety days money back no return required.

Holding the body constant is deliberate. This is a hook test.

cards.title: AUDIT
cards.text:
Law 9: PASS after one rewrite. 01C originally ran 'it is not a compliment. It is a thing you have to explain', which tripped the negation-affirmation blocker. Rewritten to 'it lands as something you have to explain'.

Law 2: PASS. No invented study, percentage, doctor or customer quote. 01D flagged as creative choice per the angle record.

Swap test: PASS, body unchanged from Ad 1.

Shelf life: evergreen.
